name: Snaplii Agent-to-Merchant Payments Gateway API
description:
Browse gift cards, make purchases, pay bills, and transfer funds.
Exchange an API key for an access token to call protected operations.

This is the contract between the gateway and Snaplii's own clients, the Snaplii CLI and the
Snaplii MCP server. AI agents must not call it directly: use the Snaplii Agent Skill with the
CLI, or the Snaplii MCP server, which apply the rules in info.x-agent-rules.
